authoredNote: Written from the M60/S3 ruling; spellings and lines recorded from the post-fix run. The two DEFECT shapes are pinned by what they must NOT publish, because both defects PUBLISHED an edge — an emission-only fixture cannot fail on either. A symbol constraint is matched field-for-field against the published symbol object, which carries `range` and not `line`, so no expectSymbols row may use `line` — the line is pinned on the RELATIONSHIP instead, where line_number is a real constraint. Relationship rows do carry line_number.
rationale: M60/S3 — an anonymous class's name is synthetic, so it must be canonical (the analyzer's own rule, #924: 'a SYNTHETIC name must be canonical — never source text'). The head-type walk is STRUCTURAL and returns nothing for a shape with no reachable type_identifier, so the canonical `anonymous_object` fallback is reached. Measured on 400 files per corpus: cats-effect 20 of 291 anonymous symbols carried source text (`anonymous_(IO ~> F)` x18), scala3 15 of 191 (including two multiline names). After the walk: 0 and 0.
